name: Vincent von Büren
headline: Senior IT Consultant @ ipt
major: M.Sc. Electrical Engineering and Information Technology
summary:
As a Senior Consultant at ipt Consulting (CH), I specialize in Cloud Native Technologies while also driving initiatives in improv and storytelling. With a diverse background in Law & Economics, Electrical Engineering, and Management, I have cultivated a deep interest in Software Development, Robotics, and Artificial Intelligence. My passion for software development has led me to contribute to establishing Switzerland's largest Tech Conference, showcasing my commitment to the tech community.

I am dedicated to continuous learning and staying abreast of technological advancements, particularly in the realms of front-end and back-end design. I thrive on being involved in the full product development cycle, from initial design to deployment. This holistic approach allows me to craft solutions that are both technically robust and user-centric.

Beyond my professional endeavors, I have a penchant for non-fiction literature, standup comedy, travel, and outdoor sports. My multidisciplinary background, combined with a curiosity-driven mindset, empowers me to deliver innovative solutions in Software Development that create value for both businesses and society.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
As a software developer at Scandio, I supported my co-workers in their projects, leveraging my expertise in a range of programming languages and technologies including Java (Atlassian SDK), JavaScript, TypeScript, React, NodeJS, and Python.

During my time with the Bosch Home Appliances team, I contributed to developing API gateway solutions for various home appliance devices. It was my responsibility to ensure the stability, security, and usability of the API gateways. I utilized TypeScript to maintain and optimize the gateways, while JEST was employed for comprehensive testing and quality assurance.

On the front end, I took charge of curating the API platform, utilizing the React framework to develop interfaces that were not only visually appealing but also intuitive, enhancing the overall user experience.

positions.title: President
positions.description:
START Global was founded 1998 at the University of St.Gallen. Today it is an internationally positioned organization whilst being locally anchored within European start-up hubs. Not only, does STARTglobal organize the biggest Tech conference in Switzerland, START Summit, but alsom lays ground for fostering and accelerating regional entrepreneurship ecosystems, with events such as START Nework or START Hack.

In my second year at STARTglobal, as president of the organisation, I was not only responsible for building the START network, but also for organising the START Summit conference. I had a team of 35 enthuastic students which worked days and nights for the success of STARTglobal

The START Summit 14/15 welcomed a total of 1500 international and entrepreneurship enthusiastic participants. During the two days of the event not only state-of-the-art technologies were presented, but also cooperations with organizations such as UnternehmerTUM, or Entrepreneurship Club ETH were consolidated. In addition, the most innovative start-up was honoured with a prize money of 15000CHF by a renowned jury.
